notes.title: New Update: Version 4.2.0
notes.content:
New Update: Version 4.2.0

Barracks Overhaul:
You can now select weapons and view the weapon model along with its skin. Rotate the model for a closer inspection and more detailed look.

Server Improvements:
Optimizations have been made on the server side for better performance and stability.

Weapon Recoil & Spray Adjustments:
Significant reduction in recoil and spray, providing more precision while moving, but still maintaining competitive integrity (standing still remains optimal for accuracy).

Group System Overhaul:
The group system has been improved for smoother handling when joining a group. A new button has been added to easily copy and share the group code.

Matchmaking Update:
During the Alpha/Beta phases, Competitive Ranks will no longer influence matchmaking.

Player Card Fix in Barracks:
A bug causing incorrect rank display has been fixed.

Competitive Mode Fix (Search and Destroy):
A bug that caused the bomb to explode when the defending team was fully eliminated (without the bomb being planted) has been fixed. Attacker teams now no longer earn double points for eliminating defenders and bomb explosion.

UI Improvements:
- Player portraits for both teams are now visible at the top of the screen. Dead players' portraits will show with an "X".
- Displays now indicate if a player has connection issues or leaves the game, resulting in penalties.

Team Colors Update:
Attackers and Defenders no longer have fixed colors (Red and Blue). The colors now reflect team affiliation:
- Red is always the enemy.
- Blue is your team (friendly).
- We're considering whether Attackers and Defenders should get their own distinct colors or if Red will always be the enemy and Blue the friendly team.

Exit Button in Main Menu:
A new X button has been added in the top corner of the main menu, allowing players to exit the game before connecting to the master server, even before pressing "Authenticate".

notes.title: Sounds of War - 3.8.0
notes.content:
Fixed Bug with Pause Menu and Buy Menu:
Fixed a bug where moving and clicking on the Pause menu or Buy Menu for weapons would cause your player to float. This issue has been resolved.

Fixed Bug with Bomb Planting/Defusing:
There was a bug that allowed players to move and shoot while planting or defusing the bomb. This has been fixed.

Fixed Weapon Pickup Persistence:
When you picked up weapons from the ground, it didn't save them for the next round. This has been fixed.

Updated Barracks UI:
The Barracks UI has been updated. You will now see your Player Call Sign (Player Banner) and the weapons next to it where you can select skins for each weapon currently in the game.
Clicking on your Banner will open a new window where you can select a Banner you own. Similarly, clicking on a weapon will show the skins you own for that gun.

New Loading Screen Information:
The loading screen when opening the game has been updated to show more information to help troubleshoot if something goes wrong.

Playtest Competitive Gamemode Rounds:
While the Playtest is ongoing, the Competitive Gamemode will only go for 5 rounds instead of 12. This will be changed upon release.

Rank Rating System Added:
We have added a Rank Rating system. Every player now has a Level (for gamemodes like TDM, FFA, BR, etc.) and a Ranking for the Competitive Gamemode. The Rank UIs are currently a work in progress and will change during the Playtest phase.
Losing a game means losing Rating Points, and winning a game means gaining Rating Points. The calculation is based on many factors such as your KDA, the duration of the round, your headshot rate, shooting errors, planted/defused bombs, the margin of victory, and more.

Zombie Mode in Development:
A zombie mode is currently being worked on and will be playable as a Party (2-5 players).

notes.title: Sounds of War - 3.7.0
notes.content:
Barracks Skins Selection:
Players can now select skins for the following weapons in the Barracks: AKM, MP5, F1, Sniper, Shotgun, M1911, Revolver, Knife. These weapons will be available during the Playtest and Early Access.

Future Skins:
More skins will be added in the future, some unlocked by leveling up, others available for purchase. These skins will not alter weapon stats such as damage or accuracy to maintain competitive integrity; they are purely cosmetic.

Matchmaking Bug Fixes:
Fixed issues where parties were being split into different teams during matchmaking.

New Co-op Mode "Zombie Unleashed":
Players can now start a private round as a party and fight against zombies.

Player Banner Updates:
Player banners will now display the rank earned through the rating system instead of levels, allowing players to proudly showcase their rank.

Server-Side Improvements:
Numerous server-side changes have been made to enhance speed and performance for players.

Crosshair Movement:
Adjustments have been made to crosshair movement for a better feel.

ODIN Voice Chat Options:
Players can now choose between Push to Talk or Always On for ODIN Voice Chat, and select a hotkey for Push to Talk.

Important: Easy Anti-Cheat Added:
Easy Anti-Cheat (EAC) has been implemented to prevent cheaters from infiltrating the game. Additionally, our own anti-cheat system is continuously being developed and integrated.

notes.title: Sounds of War - 3.2.0
notes.content:
Loading Screen Overhaul:
The loading screen now displays your team, their banners, and ranks.

Settings Update:
Music, voice chat, UI, and SFX can now be adjusted separately.

Scoreboard Enhancement:
In competitive game modes, the scoreboard now shows your teammates' credits.
For other modes like FFA or SND, the scoreboard displays the score.

Credit System Fix:
Fixed an issue where credits could go negative.
Players can now have a maximum of 10,000 credits and a minimum of 0 credits.

Friends List Improvements:
The online status of friends is now displayed as usual.
Additionally, it shows if a friend is currently in a game.

Profile Redesign:
Profiles now feature large banners instead of small ones for better visibility.

notes.title: Sounds of War - 3.1.0
notes.content:
New Update: Version 3.1.0

Friends List Added:

 You can now send and delete friend requests.

Expanded Crosshair Settings:

 Share your crosshair settings with others.

In-Game Buy Menu:

 Added a buy menu. Players now start with only a M1911 and a knife. You must purchase weapons with earned money.
 Starting funds: $1000.
 Earn $1700 per round win, $900 per round loss, and $200 per kill.
 Ammunition must be purchased separately.

Server-Side Improvements:

 Significant cleanup and introduction of AES encryption for specific data queries.

"PLAY" Tab Introduced:

 Replaces "Multiplayer" tab. Future updates will allow creating a 5-player party and selecting game modes.

Enhanced Player Banners:

 Large banners now displayed on the player card, making it easier to showcase your style.

Lobby Redesign:

 The lobby has been reorganized to look cleaner and more visually appealing.

Weapon Icons Updated:

 Improved weapon icons for better clarity and aesthetics.

New Look for Main Menu:

 The main menu has been revamped for a fresh appearance.

ODIN Voice Chat Added:

 Introducing ODIN VoiceChat, currently in the test phase.

notes.title: Sounds of War - 3.0.0
notes.content:
New Major Update: Version 3.0.0

- Gameplay Mechanics Update:
  - The gameplay mechanics have undergone significant changes, with strafing and other movements now faster.
  - The Mouselook script has been revamped for improved responsiveness.

- Crosshair Customization:
  - Introducing a Crosshair Menu in the Settings, allowing players to customize various aspects of their crosshair, including static settings and size adjustments while moving.

- Optimization and Cleanup:
  - The game's source code has been thoroughly optimized, resulting in a 3GB reduction in file size and faster loading times.
  - Graphics enhancements include improved anti-aliasing (AA) and motion blur effects.

- Main Menu Redesign:
  - The main menu has been updated with a new layout designed to be more future-proof, with ongoing improvements planned.

- New Skin: AKM UWU:
  - Discover the new AKM UWU skin by launching the game and checking it out!

- Map Adjustments:
  - In alignment with Sounds of War's focus on ranked and competitive gameplay, adjustments have been made to several maps. Harbor Havoc, Wasteland, and Subway have been retired to accommodate this shift.
  - During the playtest phase, new maps will be introduced mainly as outline prototypes to thoroughly test map structures for Search & Destroy gameplay (featuring 1-3 ways and spot names).

- Bug Fixes:
  - Fixed an issue where players sometimes wouldn't respawn after the first round.

Experience the enhanced gameplay mechanics, customizable crosshairs, optimized performance, updated main menu, new AKM UWU skin, map adjustments, and bug fixes in Version 3.0.0! Your feedback is valuable as we continue to refine and improve Sounds of War.

notes.title: Sounds of War - Changelog 2.6.0
notes.content:
**New Update: Version 2.7.0**

Profile Redesign:
  - Profiles in the main menu now feature a revamped design. Additionally, the last rounds played by a player are now displayed. The Last Rounds section shows whether a player won, lost, or drew the round, along with their kill count, death count, map, and game mode.

Settings Overhaul:
  - Settings have been revamped for improved functionality and user experience.

Network Sound Fix:
  - Fixed an issue where some players' shots were not audible over the network at certain points.

Player Animation Synchronization:
  - Addressed an issue where player animations were not synchronized properly over the network at certain points.

notes.title: Sounds of War - Changelog 2.5.0
notes.content:
Search & Destroy:

 Added a 30-second warm-up phase to Search & Destroy. 
After each round, there will be 30 seconds of warm-up followed by a 2-minute timer until the attackers plant the bomb or the defending team is eliminated. 
If the attackers are eliminated and the bomb has been planted, the defending team must defuse the bomb. Failure to do so results in victory for the attackers.
 During the warm-up, a large wall exists in each spawn area to allow teams to strategize defense and attack tactics.

Main Menu:

 Added an Invitation Button in the main menu. If a friend has a code, you can use it to join their room.

notes.title: Sounds of War - Changelogs 2.4.0
notes.content:
New Updates Sounds of War - Changelogs 2.4.0


 Players are no longer able to spawn in Search & Destroy.
 Once all players in a team are eliminated, the round is lost for that team, and the round restarts.
 The spawn button has been removed from the Base Menu (when dead) in Search & Destroy.
 Ranked matches can only start when there are at least 5 players on each team; for Unranked matches, there must be at least 3 players on each team.
 Private rooms can now be created, exclusively for unranked matches.
 Weapon spray patterns have been adjusted and improved.
 The Friends list has been revamped; you can now see when a friend is in a room and join them accordingly.

notes.title: Sounds of War - Changelog 2.3.0
notes.content:
Player HUD Revamp:

 The player HUD has been redesigned.
 The health bar is no longer a slider but displays your health precisely in text.
 Kill combo notifications (first kills, second kill, etc., up to headshot) now have a new appearance to match the updated HUD design.


Harbor Havoc Map Changes:

 The Harbor Havoc map has been adjusted.
 Weather conditions have been made slightly darker with rain to create a more atmospheric ambiance.

These updates bring improvements to the player HUD and enhance the atmosphere of the Harbor Havoc map. Enjoy the enhanced gaming experience! If you have any feedback or encounter any issues, please don't hesitate to let us know.

notes.title: Sounds of War - Changelog 2.2.0
notes.content:
Search & Destroy Round End Fix:

 Corrected the round ending in Search & Destroy to ensure that the round now ends after completing 12 rounds as originally intended.

Timer Reset after Round Actions:

 The timer is now reset only after the round is restarted following bomb defusal, planting, or expiration. Previously, the timer was immediately reset and counted down before the round was restarted.

Background Round Tracking:

 Each round is now stored in the background, including the winning and losing teams. This provides a better overview of which team won or lost each round, visible in the UI.

Main Menu UI Overhaul:

 The UI in the main menu under "Multiplayer" has been revamped. Separate buttons for "Ranked" and "Unranked" for Search & Destroy have been added to better distinguish between game modes.

Search for Free Lobbies:

 Lobby search now looks for free, unstarted rooms. If no rooms are found, a room for Ranked or Unranked is automatically created.

Separate Buttons for Other Game Modes:

 Separate buttons for Team Deathmatch (Unranked), FFA, and Last Man Standing (Unranked) have been added to facilitate room creation for these game modes.

QuickMatch for Unranked Games:

 The QuickMatch button now only searches for Unranked games. For a Ranked game, the corresponding "Ranked" button must be pressed.

Stability Fixes and Harbor Havoc Glitch Corrections:

 Several stability fixes have been implemented, including corrections for glitches in Harbor Havoc that caused players to be ejected from the map due to specific exploits.

Server-Side Stability Improvements:

 Significant stability improvements have been made on the server side to enhance overall gameplay experience.

Red Rusty AKM Skin Adjustment:

 The Red Rusty AKM skin, which occasionally experienced issues with infinite ammo, has been rectified. (Note: The fix addresses an occasional issue where the Red Rusty AKM skin erroneously granted unlimited ammunition.)

These updates not only address gameplay enhancements and stability fixes but also ensure a smoother overall experience for players. If further adjustments are desired or questions arise, feel free to reach out.

notes.title: Sounds of War - Changelog 2.1.0
notes.content:
New Update: Version 2.1.0

- Removed Takeaway Animation:
  - The takeaway animation for all weapons has been removed to enable faster weapon switching.

- Spray Control Adjustment:
  - The spray control of weapons while shooting has been slightly reworked to ensure improved accuracy.

- Faster Weapon Switching:
  - Weapons can now be switched much faster by pressing keys 1, 2, 3, or 4, or using the scroll wheel.

- Changes to Combat Knife:
  - The Combat Knife now deals 30 damage on the first hit and 38 damage on the second hit to increase its effectiveness.

- Player Mobility Adjustments:
  - Player mobility has been adjusted to allow for better maneuverability. Hiding, peeking, and re-hiding around corners now occur more quickly and smoothly.

- No Delay in Jumping:
  - Players can now jump consecutively without delay. However, movement will slow down after multiple jumps, without any delay between them.

- MP5 Damage Adjustment:
  - Damage for the MP5 has been changed from 25 to 29.

- Static Crosshair:
  - The crosshair is now static. Work is currently underway on the UI to allow players to customize the crosshair to their liking.

notes.title: Sounds of War - Changelog 2.0.0
notes.content:
New Update: Version 2.0.0

Search & Destroy Adjustments:
- Disarming under the bridge no longer possible: Players can no longer disarm the bomb under the bridge, increasing the tactical depth and strategic value of positioning.
- Disarming or planting interrupted: Disarming or planting the bomb will be interrupted if the player dies during the process, ensuring a fair and balanced gameplay experience.

Barracks Adjustments:
- New Layout: Banners and inventory are now located in the Barracks area, simplifying navigation and organization for players.

Major Change: Weapon Spray Patterns:
- Fixed spray patterns: Adjusted weapon shooting behavior to have fixed spray patterns, aligning gameplay more towards competitive aspects and reducing luck factor.

notes.title: Sounds of War - Changelog 1.8
notes.content:
Scoreboard UI Overhaul:

 Revised the Attack and Defender UI elements within the scoreboard to prevent overlap and ensure clarity during gameplay.

 Settings UI Redesign:

 Updated the visual appearance of the Settings UI, offering a more polished and user-friendly interface for players to adjust game settings.

 Harbor Havoc Bomb Placement:

 Relocated the bomb placement in the Harbor Havoc map to the bridge area, providing a more strategic and dynamic gameplay experience.

 Search & Destroy Point Allocation Fix:

 Fixed an issue where the point score was not properly transferred when switching teams in the Search & Destroy mode, ensuring fair and accurate scoring for all players.

notes.title: Sounds of War - Changelog 1.7
notes.content:
Voice Commands Integration:

 Implemented voice cues for various in-game actions including planting, defusing, explosions, and time warnings such as "Not enough time left," enhancing immersion and player feedback during critical moments.

 In-Game Settings Fix:

 Addressed issues with in-game settings functionality, ensuring that players can adjust settings seamlessly without encountering any glitches or errors.

notes.title: Sounds of War - Changelog 1.6
notes.content:
In-Game Settings Menu: Adjusted settings accessibility by making them available in-game, providing players with more convenient access to customization options without needing to navigate through the main menu.
 Player Banners Revamp: Introduced a new banner called "Day One," exclusively reserved for playtesters, which will remain in the player's inventory upon the game's release.
 Reworked player banners to accommodate the addition of the "Day One" banner and enhance overall visual appeal and diversity.
 Rank Visual Overhaul: Modified the appearance of the first 20 ranks, offering players a refreshed visual progression experience as they advance through the game.


These updates aim to enhance player experience by providing more accessible settings, rewarding playtesters with exclusive in-game content, and refreshing visual elements to maintain engagement and excitement.

notes.title: Sounds of War - Changelog 1.5
notes.content:
Search & Destroy UI Fix: Addressed UI issues in the Search & Destroy mode, ensuring a smoother and more consistent user experience.
 Bomb Consolidation: Consolidated the bomb objective, reducing it to a single bomb instead of two, streamlining gameplay mechanics for both attacking and defending teams.
 Team Assignments:

Attackers: Buzzard (BZRD) team designation.
Defenders: PFSU team designation.

notes.title: Sounds of War - Changelog 1.4
notes.content:
Improved: Bots now wait until the round starts before engaging.
 Redesigned: Completely revamped the scoreboard UI.
 Fixed: Addressed issues in the "Search & Destroy" mode, enhancing gameplay experience.
 Fixed: Corrected the misplaced and invisible Settings Menu in the game.
 Enhanced: Increased the radius of bot grenade damage.
 Updated: Bullet impacts, explosions, and bullet trails have been altered.
 Enhanced Realism: Improved the appearance of player blood effects upon being shot.

notes.title: Sounds of War - Changelog 1.3
notes.content:
Updated: Redesigned the scoreboard UI.
 Fixed: Addressed several issues in the "Search & Destroy" game mode.
 Fixed: Several background errors with the SOW API.

notes.title: Sounds of War - Changelog 1.2
notes.content:
Fixed: UI issues in the "Search & Destroy" game mode.
 Fixed: Players now spawn correctly after the round in "Search & Destroy".
 Fixed: General errors in the main menu have been addressed.
 Improvement: Expanded our network to accommodate the increasing number of desired playtest participants.


Please note that despite the fixed UI issues in "Search & Destroy", there may still be additional issues that arise.

notes.title: Sounds of War - Changelog 1.1
notes.content:
Added for testing purposes: Search & Destroy mode. Please note that there may still be bugs present.
 Fixed issue where "suicide" was incorrectly displayed when killed by a bot.

notes.title: Sounds of War - Changelog 1.0
notes.content:
Bug fixes:


Fixed a bug in the Basemenu where the icon for "Spawn" was not being displayed.
Bots are now spawned from the lobby at the start of rounds. Previously, this only occurred when joining mid-game.
Fixed various collider boxes to prevent players from glitching out of the map.
